vlog_arc.theme: Building in public means showing the week before the results exist.

beats.mon: Leo starts the week at 5am, formula in hand, walking through exactly what this week needs to accomplish — one product goal, one content goal, one family commitment — nothing more.
beats.tue: He films the formulation notes on his desk, explaining one ingredient decision he almost reversed during R&D, because the audience deserves to know the build wasn't clean.
beats.wed: Mid-week check-in from wherever the day landed — a corner of the office, a car park after training — honest about what is ahead of plan and what is not.
beats.thu: Leo talks directly to the camera about the hardest part of building a CPG brand: the gap between knowing the product works and finding the people who need to hear it.
beats.fri: He shares one real customer message received this week, reads it without commentary for ten seconds, then says quietly: 'This is why the formula exists.'
beats.sat: Weekend morning with Gabriel and Helena briefly in frame — Leo explains that the energy to be present for this is the actual product promise, not a marketing line.
beats.sun: Leo closes the week with one honest sentence about what he learned, one thing he is carrying into next week, and a reminder that the build is slow and that is exactly right.

ig.title: Day 1 Skeptical. Day 7 Converted.
ig.angle: Open with a buyer's resistance arc quote — 'day one I didn't feel anything' — then reveal the day-7 shift to make skeptics feel seen before they object.

ig.title: Your 2pm Crash Is Not Tiredness
ig.angle: Hook with the blood-sugar mechanism most people misread as fatigue, then reframe Power Coffee as a metabolic tool, not an energy drink.

ig.title: Why I Chose Adaptogens Over More Caffeine
ig.angle: Teach the formulation decision — more caffeine accelerates the crash, adaptogens extend the curve — so followers leave with a framework, not just a product claim.

ig.title: Two Hours Before My Family Wakes
ig.angle: Show the pre-dawn routine — Ironman prep, formula in hand, house still dark — so the audience connects the product to real stakes, not a lifestyle pose.

ig.title: The Tree That Outlived Everything
ig.angle: Lead with the nuclear-blast Ginkgo survival hook, then land on what that resilience mechanism does inside your cup by 9am.

x.title: Energy Drinks Solve the Wrong Problem
x.angle: Declare that energy drinks treat low energy when the real problem is unstable energy — one sentence reframe that invites replies and shares.

x.title: The Formulation Rule I Never Break
x.angle: Share one non-negotiable from the lab — never layer two stimulants without a buffer — as a short framework thread that positions Leo as a builder with standards.

x.title: $0.73 Morning. No Crash. Do The Math.
x.angle: Run the price-math comparison against a daily latte in three lines, letting the arithmetic disarm the cost objection before anyone types it.

x.title: I'm Building This Company In Public
x.angle: Declarative confession — 'I share the losses too' — using the radical-transparency pattern to drive comments from founders who recognize the honesty.

x.title: What Two Years of Formulation Taught Me
x.angle: Three hard lessons from R&D — one ingredient that failed, one that surprised, one that defined the product — structured as a tight numbered post.

li.title: I Spent Two Years Fixing My Own Crash
li.angle: Open with the personal problem — Ironman training plus a startup equaled a 2pm collapse — then walk through the formulation journey as a founder-narrated ingredient story that LinkedIn's audience rewards over headline-led posts.

li.title: Why Most Functional Beverages Fail Founders
li.angle: Teach the three formulation mistakes that produce a spike-and-crash product, positioning Leo as an industry voice before introducing how Power Coffee was designed differently.

li.title: Caffeine Is Not Your Focus Problem
li.angle: Reframe the standard CPG narrative — caffeine quantity is the wrong metric, blood-sugar stability is the real lever — giving LinkedIn operators a shareable mental model.

li.title: A Review Stopped Me Mid-Scroll
li.angle: Story-frame a real customer result using the 'day 1 skeptical, day 7 converted' arc so the social proof reads like a case study, not an ad headline, avoiding the zero-engagement trap.

li.title: Building a CPG Brand With AI And Faith
li.angle: Transparent founder post on using AI tools without apology, weaving in the family-first and faith context that makes Leo's voice distinct and human on a platform full of polished operators.

tg.title: This Week's Numbers: Raw And Unfiltered
tg.angle: Drop the week's real metrics — orders, reach, one win, one failure — so the community feels inside the build and trusts the brand because nothing is hidden.

tg.title: What Sunday Prep Looks Like For Leo
tg.angle: Short behind-the-scenes on how the week is planned — family first block, training block, content block — making the founder's system visible and relatable.

tg.title: Why We Refuse To Add More Caffeine
tg.angle: A single clear conviction post explaining the brand's formulation line in the sand, inviting community members to share their own crash stories in reply.

tg.title: The Ingredient Most Brands Skip And Why
tg.angle: Teach one underused adaptogen from the formula — mechanism, source, dose rationale — as a community-exclusive education drop that rewards subscribers for being here.

tg.title: 430 Mornings. One Formula. Here's What Changed.
tg.angle: Use the specificity-plus-anti-marketing pattern to share Leo's personal longitudinal self-experiment, making the founder the most credible proof point in the channel.

blog.title: The Blood Sugar Crash Nobody Talks About
blog.angle: Long-form explainer on why post-caffeine crashes are metabolic events, not energy deficits, building SEO authority around the 'functional coffee' search intent.

blog.title: Ginkgo Biloba: Science Behind The Survival Claim
blog.angle: Expand the nuclear-blast hook into a fully sourced ingredient deep-dive — history, mechanism, clinical data — giving curious buyers the evidence layer that converts skeptics.

blog.title: Functional Coffee vs Energy Drinks: The Real Difference
blog.angle: Head-to-head framework post that reframes the category comparison around mechanism and duration of effect, not caffeine milligrams, making Power Coffee the obvious adult choice.

blog.title: How I Formulated Around My Family Schedule
blog.angle: Founder narrative connecting Ironman training, two kids, and a startup to the specific performance demands that drove every ingredient decision in the formula.

blog.title: What A Functional Beverage Label Should Tell You
blog.angle: Teach readers how to read an ingredient panel critically — what to look for, what to avoid, what dose thresholds matter — leaving Power Coffee's label as the implied gold standard.

em.title: Day 3 Something Shifted — A Real Story
em.angle: Lead with the buyer resistance-arc quote as the subject line, then unfold the customer's day-by-day progression to make the email feel like a testimonial letter, not a campaign.

em.title: Your Coffee Is Failing You By 2pm
em.angle: Problem-first hook in the subject line, then a tight explanation of the blood-sugar mechanism, ending with a single CTA to try the formula that was built to solve exactly this.

em.title: I Almost Quit Formulating — Here's Why I Didn't
em.angle: Founder vulnerability email sharing the hardest moment in the R&D process, grounded in faith and family stakes, making subscribers feel they are part of something that almost didn't exist.

em.title: The $0.73 Morning: A Simple Cost Breakdown
em.angle: Walk the subscriber through the full price-math comparison — daily latte, energy drink, Power Coffee — as a calm financial case that removes the last objection before purchase.

em.title: 430 Mornings In. Here Is What I Know.
em.angle: Leo's personal longitudinal proof email using the specificity pattern — exact number, anti-marketing framing — delivered as a quiet confidence note, not a sales push, with a soft link at the end.
